newsitem.title: ITALY: Prodi says Italy will be EMU founder member.
newsitem.headline: Prodi says Italy will be EMU founder member.

text.p: Prime Minister Romano Prodi was quoted as saying on Monday he had no doubts Italy would be a founder EMU member, despite question marks raised by the European Commission over Italy's fiscal credibility.

Asked by Italian reporters during a trip to Bosnia whether Italy would be ready in time for the launch of the planned single European currency, Prodi was quoted as replying: "There is no doubt about this."
Agi newsagency said Prodi told reporters that Italy had so far met European objectives, "albeit with a bit of difficulty," and added that it would continue to meet the objectives in the future.

Earlier on Monday, EU finance ministers in Brussels approved a sharply worded Commission report on the state of Italy's finances, suggesting that many of the measures taken recently to cut the budget deficit were not sustainable. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
